confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are based on aggregated 2026 travel-guide and cost-of-living snippets, not official statistics or inspected menus. Coffee is a bounded estimate because no 2026 cappuccino survey was found; the Barcelona expat figure was used only as a loose upper check. Cocktail price is a bounded estimate from Madrid, Barcelona, and Granada data points, scaled down for Córdoba and cross-checked against beer. Wine is estimated at about 1.5x the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Córdoba context (July high season, Mezquita tourism); no booking pages or listings were inspected. The FX observation was taken from RBA search snippets (RBA exchange-rates overview and homepage, 4.00 pm 18 November 2026); the RBA page itself was not opened directly, and no 19 November print was available.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized Andalusian tourist city, priced between Granada and Seville for drinks and menús del día, with cheaper bar prices than Madrid and Barcelona. Accommodation is benchmarked against comparable Spanish heritage cities (Granada, Seville, Toledo) for July demand.
